svg.title: Copper Scroll entry 39: the chamber in the second terrace
svg.text: Entry 39 (IX 4–6) — the chamber in the second terrace
Schematic plan, north up, with a side-view inset. One arrangement the text allows; not a reconstruction of any real site.
Main reading (Puech): a chamber in the second terrace, its mouth facing east
Terraces step down the slope to the east; which end the counting starts from is not given.
Here the terraces are counted from the foot, so the second is the next one up.
Features enlarged; the text gives no distances, only the depth of digging.
Slope assumed to fall east so the mouth looks downhill; terrace sizes are generic.
schematic; vertical scale for the dig only
chamber · צריח, cut into the 2nd terrace
terrace riser; hatching on the downhill side
Milik 1962: a place name, not a terrace
Milik reads Tekelet ha-Šani, a name found only in his text.
No terrace: the chamber stands at a named place.
Alternative reading · not the text shown
position at the place not given
Chamber or tower? Two senses of צריח
Phase 5: an underground chamber or hypogeum (drawn).
The atlas description has “a chamber or tower”.
Readings that change the sum, not the plan
The ½ sign and the terrace word vary between editions.
• 23½ talents: Puech 2006 and Milik 1960; the text shown keeps it.
• 24: Allegro. Lefkovits 2000 leaves the ½ sign open (1 or 2).
• Plate check: a distinct final ½ sign after three strokes (Q8).
• Puech 2002 prints בחבלה as a correction; still a terrace.
• Nothing recorded says which end the terraces are counted from.
“In the second terrace(?), in the chamber facing east, dig eight cubits and a half: 23½ talents.”
Puech's “second (vine) terrace”, as in the text shown. The terraces step down to the east and are
counted from the foot of the slope; the text says neither. The chamber is cut into the second terrace
with its mouth to the east, and the 8½ cubits are dug from its floor. No distance is given.
Possible only, low. Tekoa–Herodium sector (Puech's area for IX 4–X 4): an area of about 8 km, no site
identified (atlas-data.json). The scroll's chamber has not been identified.
Terraced land, rock-cut tombs, cisterns and caves occur in the sector, but they are undated or later
and do not narrow it to a site; Hirschfeld 1985 was not consulted (phase5_assessments.csv, DN 39-45).
